status: Exploratory follow-up defined after the primary full-release experiment; not a replacement for its frozen outcome
reason: Complete release changes can overrepresent bulk edits. Test actual small documentation commits as a distinct workload.
history: 100 commits ending at the pinned after-release revision
selection: Most recent 12 first-parent documentation commits per project with an available parent and an actual retained English documentation change
snapshot: Exact parent and commit document trees from Git objects, not a release corpus with a fabricated single-file patch
metrics: Reuse the existing scheduler/evidence-change definitions and zero/one/five/twenty sentinel controls
independence: Report unique probes, unique document families, and update events separately; repeated replay across commits is not additional independent questions
limitations: Two Python HTTP client projects; small observed history; no model-backed LightRAG or semantic answer quality claim
